name: Banana Oat Pancakes
instructions: Mash bananas. Mix with oats, egg, and milk. Cook on medium heat 2-3 min per side.

name: Veggie Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat oil. Sauté garlic and onion. Add vegetables, stir-fry 5-7 min. Add soy sauce.

name: Spinach & Egg Scramble
instructions: Wilt spinach in butter. Add beaten eggs, scramble until set. Season with salt and pepper.

name: Tomato & Lentil Soup
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic. Add tomatoes, lentils and broth. Simmer 25 min. Blend partially.

name: Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal
instructions: Cook oats with milk. Top with diced apple, cinnamon and honey.

name: Pasta Primavera
instructions: Cook pasta. Sauté vegetables in olive oil with garlic. Toss with pasta and cheese.

name: Chicken & Rice Bowl
instructions: Cook rice. Sauté chicken until cooked through. Steam broccoli. Mix sauce and serve.

name: Berry Smoothie
instructions: Blend all ingredients until smooth. Add ice if desired.

name: Avocado Toast
instructions: Toast bread. Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt. Spread on toast. Top with red pepper.

name: Mushroom Omelette
instructions: Beat eggs. Melt butter in pan. Pour in eggs. Add mushrooms and cheese. Fold and serve.

name: Roasted Root Vegetables
instructions: Chop vegetables. Toss with oil and herbs. Roast at 400°F for 35-40 min.

name: Greek Salad
instructions: Chop and combine vegetables. Add olives and feta. Drizzle with olive oil and oregano.

name: Lemon Herb Salmon
instructions: Season salmon with garlic and dill. Pan-sear 4 min per side. Finish with lemon and butter.

name: Corn & Black Bean Quesadilla
instructions: Layer beans, corn, and cheese on tortilla. Cook until golden. Serve with salsa.

name: Potato & Leek Soup
instructions: Sauté leek and onion. Add potato and broth. Simmer 20 min. Blend until smooth.

name: Overnight Oats
instructions: Mix oats, milk, yogurt and chia seeds. Refrigerate overnight. Top with fruit in morning.

name: Vegetable Frittata
instructions: Sauté vegetables. Pour beaten eggs over. Cook stovetop then finish under broiler.

name: Pesto Pasta
instructions: Blend basil, garlic, nuts, and cheese with olive oil. Toss with cooked pasta.

name: Spiced Chickpea Bowl
instructions: Sauté chickpeas with spices. Add tomatoes and spinach. Serve over rice.

name: Fruit Crumble
instructions: Mix fruit with sugar. Top with oat crumble mixture. Bake at 375°F for 30 min.
